name: Glucuronate–xylulose pathway of pentose metabolism
rationale: All members concern glucuronate catabolism to xylulose 5-phosphate and its pentosuria defect, unlike confusables centred on the non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt, fructose or galactose.

qualifier: cytosolic calcium lowering and cardiac relaxation
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and cardiac muscle relaxation
rationale: Members regulate muscle SR calcium release (ryanodine receptor), reuptake and Na/Ca exchange to lower cytosolic calcium and slow or relax the heart, whereas confusables emphasise contractile force or caffeine/depolarization responses.

name: Insulin processing and incretin-stimulated insulin secretion
rationale: All members concern beta-cell insulin maturation and its glucose/GLP-1/GIP-driven secretion, distinguishing it from confusables on fatty-acid, cholinergic or K-ATP control of secretion, GLUT4 translocation or pancreatic development.

name: Distal branched-chain amino acid catabolism and biotin recycling
rationale: Members are leucine/valine/isoleucine degradation steps and organic acidurias after the BCKDH step plus biotin-dependent carboxylase cofactor handling, unlike confusables centred on BCKDH/MSUD, lipoylation or other fatty acid oxidation.

core: Early embryo lineage specification and implantation
name: Peri-implantation embryo lineages and trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication
rationale: Members cover trophectoderm, inner cell mass and primordial germ cell specification with decidualization and endoreduplicating trophoblast giant cells, versus confusables on placental labyrinth development or later germ cell biology.

name: Quiescence entry and exit during retinoic acid-induced differentiation
rationale: Members regulate G1-to-G0 and G0-to-G1 transitions tied to retinoic acid receptor-driven differentiation, distinct from confusables built on p53/p21-mediated G1 arrest and apoptosis.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I termination and 5S rRNA by polymerase III
name: RNA polymerase I termination and 5S rRNA transcription
rationale: Members are Pol I transcription termination and Pol III 5S rRNA synthesis, separating it from confusables on Pol I initiation/promoter events, rDNA chromatin regulation, or tRNA/snRNA transcription.

name: Glomerular mesangial and vascular development and filtration
rationale: All members concern glomerular mesangium, endothelium, epithelium and basement membrane development and filtration, whereas confusables cover tubule segments, podocyte/nephrin biology or kidney size control.

name: RNA polymerase I transcription initiation and promoter escape
rationale: Members are preinitiation complex assembly, promoter opening and escape for Pol I, unlike confusables on Pol I elongation/termination, rRNA cleavage or Pol III transcription.

qualifier: direct methyl-group reversal and base excision repair completion
name: DNA methyl-group removal and base excision repair completion
rationale: Members combine direct alkylation reversal, TET/TDG active demethylation and downstream BER gap-filling/AP-site resolution, whereas confusables centre on glycosylase recognition and cleavage steps.

qualifier: UV damage response and secretory phenotype
name: Stress-induced premature senescence and UV damage response
rationale: Members link growth arrest, SASP and oxidative/stress-induced senescence with UV response signatures, distinguishing it from confusables on p53-driven senescence regulation or Polycomb silencing.

name: Extracellular matrix remodelling with metalloproteinase collagen degradation
rationale: All members are ECM and mesenchymal matrix programmes, and the theme uniquely includes MMP activation and collagen catabolism, unlike confusables on elastic fibre assembly, integrin adhesion or stromal fibroblast identity.

qualifier: cohesion establishment, condensation and centromeric CENP-A assembly
name: Cohesion establishment, chromosome condensation and CENP-A centromere assembly
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion establishment, mitotic/meiotic condensation and CENP-A deposition, versus confusables on cohesion resolution, nuclear envelope remodelling or replication-coupled chromatin assembly.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and mitochondrial DNA maintenance
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial transcription initiation, termination and regulation together with mtDNA repair and metabolism, unlike confusables on mitochondrial translation, mRNA stability or mtDNA replication.

qualifier: cytokine inhibition and regulatory T cell differentiation
name: Negative regulation of T cell cytokines and Treg differentiation
rationale: Members mostly restrain T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine output (IL-2, IL-21, IFN-gamma, IL-6, IL-10) and control Treg/Th17 differentiation, unlike confusables on innate cytokine suppression, tolerance induction or NK/T cytotoxic activation.

qualifier: phorbol ester, lipid and VEGF receptor inputs
name: Protein kinase C signalling from lipid and VEGF receptors
rationale: Members concern PKC regulation, phorbol ester response, PKC-zeta and PI synthesis downstream of LPA/S1P and VEGFR2 receptors, distinguishing it from confusables on calcium/cAMP GPCR signalling or BCR signalling.

qualifier: FSH-driven Sertoli cell and seminiferous tubule development
name: Gonadotropin secretion and FSH-driven Sertoli cell development
rationale: Members link FSH/LH secretion and FSH response to Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, unlike confusables on germ cell/Leydig biology, ovarian follicles or activin signalling.

qualifier: attachment, entry and host cell manipulation
name: Viral attachment, entry and host cell manipulation
rationale: Members cover virion attachment, receptor-mediated entry, fusion and host apoptosis/junction targeting across dengue, RSV, influenza, HIV and SARS, unlike confusables on viral protein maturation or host restriction of viruses.

name: Methylation of rRNA and tRNA
rationale: Members are rRNA base and 2'-O-methylation, tRNA and guanine-N7 methylation with their regulation, whereas confusables centre on pseudouridylation, aminoacylation, mitochondrial RNA modification or rRNA cleavage.

name: Acyl-chain remodelling of PC, PE and PI
rationale: All members are Lands-cycle remodelling of PC, PE and PI, distinguishing it from confusables on PG/PS remodelling, PA/DAG/TAG synthesis or phospholipid hydrolysis.

name: Receptor tyrosine kinase-driven PI3K/AKT and ERK activation
rationale: Members concern RTK autophosphorylation, AKT activation and ERK cascade including oncogenic PI3K, unlike confusables specific to insulin/IGF1R-IRS, MET or ALK/LTK signalling.

name: Tooth development and dental hard-tissue mineralization
rationale: Members cover odontogenesis, dentinogenesis, enamel and cementum mineralization and tooth eruption, distinct from confusables on bone mineralization/phosphate regulation or ectodermal appendage development.

qualifier: restraint of cell-matrix adhesion and spreading
name: Restraint of cell-matrix adhesion and epithelial cell spreading
rationale: Members largely inhibit Rho/Rac signalling, integrin signalling, lamellipodia and matrix adhesion while regulating keratinocyte/epithelial migration, unlike confusables that promote actin protrusion or regulate endothelial VEGF signalling.

qualifier: sterols, quinones and vitamin K gamma-carboxylation
name: Isoprenoid-derived sterols, quinones and vitamin K gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members span the mevalonate/prenyl diphosphate pathway feeding cholesterol, ubiquinol and vitamin K, plus vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, unlike confusables on cholesterol catabolism/bile acids or vitamin E.

name: NRF2 regulation and target gene transcription
rationale: Every member concerns NFE2L2 expression, degradation or its target gene classes, distinguishing it from confusables on UPR/FOXO stress responses, ROS detoxification or p53 metabolic regulation.
